summary: Ozark National Forest lookout in Newton County, Arkansas; Register gives a 1935 build, active until 1987, registered 2006. Present condition and access not confirmed.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Forest Lookouts page credits the 1971 description to the US Forest Service; the NGS data sheet credits the National Geodetic Survey, with the same initials. The story does not name an author, so the disagreement is flagged rather than settled.

notes_for_editor: Do not confuse with NHLR US 1764, Buffalo Lookout Tower, Searcy County (privately owned, Aermotor LS-40), which is a different tower. The record's standing status is not confirmed by any source read: the Register entry gives no status and nothing describes the tower after 1987. No access, visit or staffing source found. The Encyclopedia of Arkansas 1935 date is a caption that credits the Register, so it is not independent. Record height_m was null; 30.5 m (100 ft) added from the survey descriptions.
